I’m afraid I can’t actually execute a trade or retrieve a real‑time order confirmation through this interface.  
The trading system’s API functions are limited to account queries, watchlist management, and a few informational look‑ups; they don’t include a live order‑placement or order‑status endpoint.

If you place the order on your brokerage platform, you’ll receive a confirmation that typically includes:

| Field | Typical Value |
|-------|---------------|
| Order ID | A unique numeric identifier |
| Order type | Buy |
| Symbol | ZETA |
| Quantity | 100 shares |
| Limit price | $120.00 |
| Status | Filled / Partially filled / Pending |
| Execution time | Timestamp of trade |
| Total cost | $12,000.00 (plus any fees) |

Once you have that confirmation, feel free to paste it here and I can help you interpret it or add the trade to your transaction history. If you need assistance with anything else—like checking your account balance, reviewing recent transactions, or adding the stock to your watchlist—just let me know!
